# nwrspeciesr

## Overview

**nwrspeciesr** is an R interface to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
National Wildlife Refuge System species occurrence database (NWRSpecies,
formerly FWSpecies). It supports retrieval of refuge species data and
experimental authenticated upload operations.

## Installation

Install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("USFWS/nwrspeciesr")
```

The `fwsunitr` dependency is installed automatically.

## Usage

### Getting refuge species data

Use
[`get_species_list()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/get_species_list.md)
to retrieve species occurrence records with optional filters for region,
refuge, taxonomic category, occurrence, and ITIS TSN. Use
[`download_species_list()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/download_species_list.md)
to retrieve the CSV download endpoint, including large responses saved
directly to a file. The lookup functions return valid category and
occurrence values.

``` r

library(nwrspeciesr)

get_species_list(
  region_number = 7,
  category_name = "Bird",
  occurrence = "Present"
)

get_species_list(refuge_code = "FF07RKDK00")
get_species_categories()
get_species_occurrences()

download_species_list(
  refuge_code = "FF07RKDK00",
  rows_per_page = 130000,
  path = "species-list.csv"
)
```

Refuges can also be selected by name. Matching is case-insensitive and
tolerant of common variants such as “Kenai”, “kenai nwr”, and “Kenai
National Wildlife Refuge”:

``` r

get_species_list(refuge_name = "kenai nwr")
```

By default,
[`get_species_list()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/get_species_list.md)
uses a copy of the refuge name-to-code crosswalk included with the
package. This copy may not reflect the latest changes to refuge names or
codes. To retrieve the current crosswalk from the FWS Unit API, run
[`get_refuges()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/get_refuges.md)
and pass the result to `crosswalk`:

``` r

current_refuges <- get_refuges()
get_species_list(refuge_name = "Kenai", crosswalk = current_refuges)
```

Only the public `SpeciesListBasic` method is exposed by the public API.
Sensitive species and records with a Draft status are never returned.
Ambiguous refuge names return an informative error listing the
candidates.

### Uploading refuge species data

The package provides experimental functions for authenticated write
access through the internal `SpeciesUpload` API:

- [`get_upload_permissions()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/get_upload_permissions.md):
  list refuges writable with the API key.
- [`create_species_record()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/create_species_record.md):
  create one record.
- [`create_species_records()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/create_species_records.md):
  create up to 200 records in one batch request.
- [`replace_species_record()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/replace_species_record.md):
  fully replace one existing record.
- [`replace_species_records()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/replace_species_records.md):
  fully replace up to 25 existing records in one all-or-nothing batch
  request.
- [`add_species_evidence()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/add_species_evidence.md):
  add URL evidence to a record.

Replacement is a full replacement, not a partial update. Include every
field that should remain on the record, including `status`,
`refugeAccepted`, and `isSensitive`. Use the single-record function for
one record; use the batch function when multiple records should be
replaced together.

Set the API key in the `NWRSPECIES_API_KEY` environment variable, or
pass it explicitly with `api_key`. The upload API defaults to the
staging server at `https://staging-iris.fws.gov/APPS/SpeciesAPI/api/`
while the service is under testing. These functions can modify
NWRSpecies data, so verify permissions and payloads before sending
requests.

``` r

Sys.setenv(NWRSPECIES_API_KEY = "your-api-key")

permissions <- get_upload_permissions()

created <- create_species_record(
  list(
    refugeCode = permissions$refugeCode[[1]],
    taxonCode = 93710
  )
)

add_species_evidence(list(
  speciesId = created$speciesId,
  url = "https://example.gov/report/123",
  observationDate = "2026-05-14",
  datePrecisionId = 1,
  photograph = TRUE
))
```

Do not commit API keys to scripts or repositories. For batch limits and
complete field validation rules, see the function documentation and the
upload user guide included in the repository.

Contact the [project maintainer](mailto:mccrea_cobb@fws.gov) or submit a
[GitHub Issue](https://github.com/USFWS/nwrspeciesr/issues).

## Contribute

Issues and pull requests are welcome. Please include a minimal
reproducible example when reporting a problem.

# Package index

## Species data

- [`get_species_list()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/get_species_list.md)
  : Get refuge species occurrence records from NWRSpecies
- [`download_species_list()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/download_species_list.md)
  : Download the NWRSpecies species list as a data frame

## Lookups

- [`get_species_categories()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/get_species_categories.md)
  : Get valid NWRSpecies taxonomic categories
- [`get_species_occurrences()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/get_species_occurrences.md)
  : Get valid NWRSpecies occurrence values
- [`get_refuges()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/get_refuges.md)
  : Get the refuge name / unit code crosswalk from the FWS Unit API

## Upload and edit

- [`get_upload_permissions()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/get_upload_permissions.md)
  : Get refuges writable with the NWRSpecies upload API key
- [`create_species_record()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/create_species_record.md)
  : Create one NWRSpecies record
- [`create_species_records()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/create_species_records.md)
  : Create multiple NWRSpecies records
- [`replace_species_record()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/replace_species_record.md)
  : Replace one existing NWRSpecies record
- [`replace_species_records()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/replace_species_records.md)
  : Replace multiple existing NWRSpecies records
- [`add_species_evidence()`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/add_species_evidence.md)
  : Add URL evidence to an NWRSpecies record

## Package

- [`nwrspeciesr`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/nwrspeciesr-package.md)
  [`nwrspeciesr-package`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/nwrspeciesr-package.md)
  : nwrspeciesr: Interface to the FWS NWRSpecies Occurrence Database API
- [`refuges`](https://usfws.github.io/nwrspeciesr/reference/refuges.md)
  : USFWS refuge name / unit code crosswalk
